name: Marel
description: A Dawnhart witch who speaks of molding change and sharing enemies with the woods.

description_citations.work: Innistrad: Crimson Vow: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Innistrad: Crimson Vow: card flavor text (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Marel says that faith and fortitude let people mold change.
timeline.quote: We cannot escape change, but with faith and fortitude, we can mold it to our liking.

citation.text: Change of Fortune (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Marel notes that the Dawnhart and the woods share enemies.
timeline.quote: We're not at odds with the woods. How could we be, when we share so many enemies?

citation.text: Sheltering Boughs (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
